description: Evaluate an ordered geometric octave sum over the existing 2D or 3D gradient-noise profile at supplied points.

provenance.relationship: Multi-octave field dependency of composite helper; no source-noise, packing or subdivision equivalence.
Multi-octave field dependency of composite helper; no source-noise, packing or subdivision equivalence.

output_invariants: Detached scalar values in supplied point order, finite nonnegative amplitudeSum; no mutation, aliases or ambient state.

behavior.validation: Passive Object/null-prototype record with exactly dimension,points,seed,octaves,frequency,lacunarity,amplitude,persistence,normalization,maxWork. Reject classes/accessors/symbols/extras/coercion; proxies outside interchange. Dense ordinary arrays with own data slots, no extras. Static validation order: outer carrier/keys; dimension numeric2 or3; points shape length0..2147483647 and every tuple with exactly dimension finite coordinates in array/axis order; uint32 seed; octaves integer1..2147483647; finite frequency>=0; finite lacunarity>0; finite amplitude>=0; finite persistence>=0; normalization NONE/WEIGHT_SUM and WEIGHT_SUM requires amplitude>0; nonnegative safe-integer maxWork. Canonicalize accepted zeros. Validate all inputs before work, including zero weights and empty points.
behavior.work: After full static validation compute exact integer W=(N+1)*octaves with overflow-safe arithmetic. If W exceeds maxWork or safe integer maximum, WORK_LIMIT before schedule, field creation or output allocation. One schedule event and N field-sample events per octave, including zero-weight octaves. Empty points still compute schedule and amplitudeSum with cost octaves. Output storage O(N), schedule O(octaves), total work O((N+1)*octaves). Host exhaustion is a host error; no partial output.
behavior.schedule: Before evaluating any point, build frequencies and weights in octave order starting frequency and amplitude. Set amplitudeSum=0; for each used octave store frequency/weight then amplitudeSum=amplitudeSum+weight, checking finite. Only if another octave remains: nextFrequency=frequency*lacunarity then nextWeight=weight*persistence, checking finite after each. Underflow to0 is valid. Never update past the last octave. Finite amplitudeSum is required even for NONE and empty points.
behavior.algorithm: Select existing field.gradient-noise-2d-01@0.1.0 or field.gradient-noise-3d-01@0.1.0 by dimension, with the SAME supplied seed for every octave. For each point in supplied order start sum=0. For each octave ascending: for axes x,y,(z) in that order compute q=point[axis]*frequency[octave], check finite or NUMERIC_OVERFLOW; require -9007199254740991<=q<9007199254740991 or QUERY_OUT_OF_RANGE. Sample the existing profile only after all query axes validate. Compute weighted=weight*sample then sum=sum+weighted, each finite. No skip when weight0. If WEIGHT_SUM compute value=sum/amplitudeSum once after the last octave and require finite; else value=sum. Canonicalize completed output zero. Return detached {values,amplitudeSum}; no output clamp, signed remap, compensated sum, normalization per octave or coordinate feedback.
behavior.numerics: IEEE754 binary64 separately rounded primitive operations in specified order; no FMA/reassociation or narrowing. Existing gradient profiles and hash define exact scalar samples; no host Processing/p5 noise substitution. State/shape/errors compare exactly; scalar fixture tolerance absolute1e-12 relative0. Finite arithmetic checks precede any later cancellation; underflow to zero valid. Inputs are finite, but multiplied query coordinates may violate the existing profile domain.
behavior.native_surface: p5 named exports octaveGradientNoise(input) and OctaveGradientNoiseError from octave-gradient-noise.js and package index; other targets deferred. Plain values only.
behavior.environment: No ambient noise, RNG, clock, field callbacks or host objects. Fixed seed reused each octave, no seed advance. Any coordinate offset is supplied by caller before frequency scaling; no per-octave offset or independent seed.
behavior.adapter: Native p5 Canvas2D study maps returned scalar values to mark size/color on retained positions. Renderer never evaluates noise or recomputes accumulation; save exports the rendered canvas.

errors.WORK_LIMIT: Exact schedule+sampling events exceed budget/safe bound.
errors.NUMERIC_OVERFLOW: Nonfinite schedule, query product, weighted sample, sum or normalized result.
errors.QUERY_OUT_OF_RANGE: Finite multiplied coordinate outside existing gradient profile half-open safe query domain.

review.status: Root contract accepted before implementation; independent challenge resolved in design_review. Target acceptance pending.

exclusions: Processing/p5 source-noise replay, simplex or value-noise generators
Signed recentering, absolute/ridged/product multifractals and nonlinear per-octave shaping
Independent per-octave seeds, offsets, arbitrary frequency/weight lists or spatial warp
Geometry subdivision, packing, source scene or ambient time/RNG
